description:
`log` records activity entries against one of your enrollments, so you and the service's provider can see what a scheduled job or app did.

The gateway handles `POST /log` itself: it checks your key, resolves `X-UnitySVC-Enrollment` to one of your active enrollments (shared, or your own), stamps each entry's identity from the key and the enrollment (never from the body) and its timestamp from the time it was received, and writes the entries to the enrollment's activity log. A request carries one entry or an array of up to 100: `level` (`debug`, `info`, `warn` or `error`), `message` (up to 1 KB) and optional `attributes` (up to 4 KB of JSON). An oversized entry is rejected with 413, never truncated, and one bad entry rejects the whole batch. A `202` means the entries are stored; if storage is unavailable the request fails with 503 and nothing is recorded. An unknown code, someone else's enrollment, or a paused or cancelled enrollment answers 404. Entries are kept for 90 days. `log` is free: nothing on this path is metered or billed.

POST JSON to `/log` with your UnitySVC key and the enrollment's code in `X-UnitySVC-Enrollment`. Read the entries back under **Activity** on the Enrollments page.
name: log
summary: POST log entries to `/log` with an enrollment's code, and UnitySVC records them in that enrollment's activity log. Free.
